youscooper rona nikka biason tungkol sa unang video rito na kinuha nitong july 23 isang lalaki ang hindi nagalinlangan na magkabit ng lubid sa puno sa kabila ng ilog upang magkaroon ng balsa bilang pansamantalang transportasyon ng mga residente doon sana mabigyang pansin ng ating gobyerno ang halos dekada na naming hinaing na sana kahit tulay na pantao lang ay malagyan ito ayon kay rona na kumuha ng video nakararanas umano sila ng biglang pagtaas ng tubig sa ilog dahilan upang umabot ng lampasleeg hanggang lampastao ang taas nito makikita rito ang ilan pang video na pinadala ni youscooper rona na nangyari umano sa mga sumunod na araw mula july 24 hanggang 26 2025 dagdag ni rona noong mga araw na iyon mayroong tulay na maaaring daanan pero kailangan pa ring tumawid sa ilog at mayroon ding ibang daanan pero may mga nakaharang na landslide matapos magpadala ang gma integrated news noong july 25 ng paglagom ng hinaing ni youscooper rona at link patungo sa kaniyang video sa dostphivolcs emphasized the vital role of drr focal persons in every school facilitating the conduct of evacuation drills checking safety plans and hazard information awareness your work may not always be seen but it makes a big difference we hope that this training gives you something useful to bring back and more than anything we hope it reminds you that what you do mattersquietly steadily and every single day dr bacolcol added participants learned various topics related to volcanoes earthquakes and tsunami information from dostphivolcs resource speakers ms fatima m moncada science research specialist srs ii discussed key principles in drrm laws and frameworks child rights convention understanding hazards and disasters ms lucille rose d sanico senior srs shared the overview of volcanic eruption hazards and impacts she also imparted her insights on understanding volcano alert level scheme and what to do before during and after a volcanic eruption a learning activity on precursory signs of an impending volcanic eruption assessed the takeaways of the participants on the given discussions ms joan c salcedo supervising srs tackled the overview of earthquake hazards and impacts lastly ms moncada lectured on landslide preparedness to the participants being situated in an area vulnerable to earthquakes this workshop is an opportunity to empower teachers and drr focal situated on taal volcano island tvi have been recording a pronounced increase in realtime seismic energy measurement or rsam simultaneous with continuing volcanic tremor a total of nineteen 19 volcanic earthquakes has been recorded by the tvn since 09 august 2025 visual observations noted a moderate to voluminous plume from the taal main crater since the start of rsam increase taal has been main crater may lead to a phreatic or even a minor phreatomagmatic eruption dostphivolcs reminds the public that alert level 1 prevails over taal volcano which means that it is still in abnormal volcanic so2 increases and exposure of their communities and undertake appropriate response measures to mitigate the health impacts of these hazards lastly civil aviation authorities must also advise earthquake and tsunami alerting module etam and tsunami simulation and impact module tsusim of the rapid earthquake damage assessment system redas software engr angelito g lanuza supervising science research specialist srs discussed the phivolcs earthquake intensity scale peis and the natural signs of an impending local tsunami while mr nico b anilao project technical aide vi presented the philippine tsunami network and tsunami early warning system tews visualization to fully understand the role of community participation in disaster preparedness ms joan c salcedo supervising srs
